nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, initialized to msg.sender in the constructor and gating the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
TokenBEP20.symbol public token symbol set in the constructor.
TokenBEP20.name public token name set in the constructor.
TokenBEP20.decimals public token decimals (8).
TokenBEP20._totalSupply total token supply, minted to owner in the constructor.
TokenBEP20.newun: blacklist/anti-transfer address; transfers to this address are blocked and it can be set implicitly inside transferFrom.
TokenBEP20.balances mapping of holder balances, debited/credited in transfer and transferFrom.
TokenBEP20.allowed allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount) mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance debits, allowances and ether destination.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages the new owner address.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then transfers ownership.
TokenBEP20.transfernewun(address _newun) onlyOwner: sets the restricted address.
TokenBEP20.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
TokenBEP20.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): view returning balances[tokenOwner].
TokenBEP20.transfer(address to, uint tokens): requires to != newun, moves balances via SafeMath and emits Transfer.
TokenBEP20.approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] unconditionally and emits Approval.
TokenBEP20.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance, moves balances and can implicitly set the newun blacklist address.
TokenBEP20.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): view returning the allowed mapping entry.
TokenBEP20.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then invokes the spender callback, state is written before the external call.
TokenBEP20 fallback: payable but always reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
CRYPTOVISA.clearCNDAO() onlyOwner: sends the whole contract ether balance to msg.sender.
CRYPTOVISA fallback: empty payable receive function, accepts ether without accounting.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, address(this), data) performed from approveAndCall.
Ether transfer _owner.transfer(address(this).balance) draining the contract balance to the owner inside clearCNDAO.
SafeMath subtraction/addition of balances and allowances in transfer/transferFrom; allowance must remain sufficient or the call reverts.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter _newun of transfernewun.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Parameter to (recipient) of transfer.
Parameter tokens (amount) of transfer.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter tokens (allowance amount) of approve.
Parameter from (debited holder) of transferFrom.
Parameter to (credited holder) of transferFrom.
Parameter tokens (amount) of transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, which becomes the untrusted callee address.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall.
Parameter data of approveAndCall, forwarded verbatim to the external callback.
Local variable _owner (address payable) in clearCNDAO, holding msg.sender as the ether recipient.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the owner state variable is directly derived from untrusted caller input.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which requires msg.sender == owner; caller identity controls privileged ownership transfer.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership, so caller identity decides who becomes owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the caller-controlled address the source of the token movement.
transferFrom spends and debits allowed[from][msg.sender], tying caller identity to the allowance accounting.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callback.
clearCNDAO derives the ether recipient directly from msg.sender and is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner.
approveAndCall performs an arbitrary external callback receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender address, an untrusted reentrant callee.
The approval stored in the allowed mapping is already committed before the external callback executes, allowing the callee to re-enter with a live allowance.
clearCNDAO executes the ether transfer of the entire contract balance to the owner, a privileged fund-draining operation.
transferFrom performs SafeMath subtraction on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] plus addition on balances[to], the arithmetic accounting of the allowance flow.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for both the sender and the recipient.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping of from and to.
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender], mutating the allowance mapping.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the supplied amount.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before invoking the callback.
transfernewun, guarded by onlyOwner, writes the restricted address newun.
transfer checks require(to != newun) before moving tokens, gating recipients against the restricted address.
transferFrom silently assigns newun = to when newun is zero, letting a caller-controlled recipient establish the transfer blacklist.
transferOwnership stages the caller-supplied address into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the ownership handover.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the privileged transferOwnership state write.
The _newun parameter flows into the onlyOwner-controlled transfernewun state write.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping read in balanceOf.
The to parameter is the credited recipient in transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
The spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping written in approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance amount stored in approve.
The from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credited recipient in transferFrom and can become newun.
The tokens parameter is the amount subtracted from balances and allowances in transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping read in allowance.
The spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping read in allowance.
The spender parameter is used as the allowance key and later as the untrusted external callee address.
The tokens parameter is stored in allowed and forwarded to the callback in approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval callback, carrying attacker-controlled payload into the untrusted callee.
The local _owner (msg.sender) flows into the ether transfer of the whole contract balance in clearCNDAO.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists as the input of transferOwnership and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter _newun only feeds the transfernewun state write and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used as the lookup key inside balanceOf and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter to is only meaningful as the transfer recipient inside transfer and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter tokens of transfer has no standalone semantics and should be folded into the transfer function node.
Parameter spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter tokens of approve is only the stored allowance value and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter from is only meaningful as the debited account inside transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter to is only meaningful as the credited recipient inside transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom has no standalone semantics and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used for the allowance lookup inside allowance and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter spender is only used for the allowance lookup inside allowance and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall is only used as allowance key plus callee address and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall has no standalone semantics and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call and should be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
Local variable _owner exists solely to hold msg.sender as the recipient of the balance transfer in clearCNDAO and should be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
